needs_human.note: The SceneCard's total min-height of 7.6rem replaces per-line reservations, so a scene with a one-line label and no text now leaves its spare space at the card's foot rather than between the label and the text. This applies at every width, not only in wide hosts.
The card's fixed min-height (7.6rem), with the spare space at its foot, is not stated in the spec. Only design-check D-1 and decisions.md record it.
